export.justification: Legacy multi-platform export wizard. Superseded in UXP by 'deliverables' which folds OTIO + AAF + IMF + Dolby Vision planning into one tab. CEP 'export' tab will be retired with CEP at ~2026-09; do not invest further. F252 migration consideration.

nlp.justification: Legacy natural-language command tab. The F143 chat-conductor RFC (AGENT_UX_RFC.md) replaces this with a side-panel '/agent/chat' surface that ships first in UXP (F143/F252 sequencing). CEP 'nlp' tab will be retired with CEP at ~2026-09.

search.justification: UXP got the FTS5 transcript-index search surface as a dedicated tab; CEP keeps the same backend via the 'nlp' command palette. After CEP EOL the UXP 'search' tab becomes the canonical surface.

deliverables.justification: UXP-first replacement for CEP 'export'. Hosts OTIO/AAF/FCPXML interchange, IMF/Dolby Vision/ADM BW64 planning presets (F245-F248), VFX sheets, ADR, music cues, asset inventories.
deliverables.cep_equivalent: export tab + Timeline -> Export menu items

agent.justification: UXP-first surface for the 2026-05-25 backend batch: F143 chat conductor + F144 self-review, Q3 one-click Enhance, Q7/F273 Sequence Index, Q8 shorts A/B variants, and F146 MCP bridge. Lands in UXP only because the F252 WebView migration story routes all new conductor + agent work post-CEP-EOL through UXP. CEP users reach equivalent functionality via the command palette + NLP tab.

feature_route_classifications.uxp-pending: The CEP route has no literal UXP entrypoint yet and must be migrated before CEP retirement.
feature_route_classifications.cep-terminal: The legacy CEP route will retire without an exact UXP route because a successor workflow replaces it.
feature_route_classifications.intentional: The route asymmetry is deliberate and has an equivalent, alias, or UXP-first product surface.

cep_only.justification: Audio production, generation, installation, waveform, and silence-speed controls still require UXP entrypoint wiring before CEP retirement.
Caption burn-in, WhisperX, interview polish, transcript utilities, and Whisper maintenance remain CEP-only feature controls that need UXP coverage.
The video editing and AI controls in this group have implemented backend routes but no literal UXP entrypoint and are owned by the video migration lane.
Batch, template, timeline mutation, and saved-workflow controls need direct UXP affordances rather than relying on the CEP workflow surface.
Panel operations, diagnostics, settings portability, queues, models, presets, and onboarding need equivalent UXP controls before CEP is removed.
These CEP compatibility routes are intentionally asymmetric: UXP uses /captions/styles, /video/auto-zoom, and the shared /captions/animated/render flow respectively.
The legacy CEP export preset browser and thumbnail helper terminate with the CEP export tab; UXP deliverables and /export/preset are the supported successor workflow.

uxp_only.justification: Agent planning/review, one-click enhancement, shorts variants, chat, and MCP information are intentionally UXP-first surfaces documented by the agent tab decision.
Sequence Index is an intentional UXP-first workflow attached to the UXP search and agent surfaces.
UXP owns the modern caption-style alias, auto-zoom and colour-match actions, and depth controls; CEP uses older aliases or shared fallback routes where applicable.
Plugin uninstall is intentionally exposed in the newer UXP trust-management surface while CEP retains install, quarantine, registry, trust, and worker controls.

$policy: When a tab or literal backend-route reference is added to either panel, update this ledger. Tab tests and the generated feature-parity gate fail on every unannotated or stale divergence, including any new CEP-only route.
